Trend cooling: Israel recognised Somaliland on 26 Dec 2025 (Sa'ar in Hargeisa in January 2026, embassies announced), a new Taiwan office opened in June 2026, and Washington has discussed a naval-base-for-recognition swap. Bond kin: Mogadishu's whole case rests on the shared Somali nation and the 1960 union (Hargeisa's own bond to Mogadishu is a grievance, which is not this stance).
